notes.title: Heroines of Swords & Spells 2 will be released on November 7, 2025.
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36812856/4c6e866d4cd1120f8c81610c3adebab830bc9613.png"][/img][/p][p]Apologies to those who were expecting the game specifically in September. Testing took longer than originally planned. To avoid having to rush out a “Day 1 patch,” followed by a “Day 2 patch,” and so on (turning players into unpaid testers), we decided to move the release date to November 7, 2025. [/p][p]I hope you’ll stick with us until then!  [/p][p]There’s also good news! We’ve managed to resolve the issue of transferring saves from the first Heroines of Swords & Spells. A patch will be released soon along with detailed instructions on how to carry over your saves. Those who want to try the feature can already test save transfers in the Heroines of Swords & Spells 2 demo.  [/p][p]And if you really can’t wait to play and would like to help test the game, please contact me at [url="https://kirillp1985@gmail.com"]kirillp1985@gmail.com[/url].  [/p][p]Once again, sorry for the delay. Five years of development are slowly but surely coming to an end, and the wait is almost over. I truly hope the game won’t disappoint you in the end!  [/p][p]P.S. Don't forget to [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3567620/Heroines_of_Swords__Spells_2/"]wishlist[/url] the game to make sure you don’t miss the release![/p]

notes.title: Announcing the Demo for Heroines of Swords and Spells 2!
notes.notes:
The demo includes the full story of the first part (excluding the "Green Furries" DLC). This means: you should only buy the original game for Steam cards, achievements, or to support the developer — thank you for your help!

The new content in Heroines of Swords and Spells 2 will take about 2–3 hours (out of total 50), but it promises to be packed with action and showcase how much the game has evolved since the release of the first part.

Overall, completing the demo will take around 10 hours — 8 hours from the first act and 2 hours from the second. For longtime fans wanting to “refresh their memory,” this demo is the perfect way to do so. The developer eagerly awaits your feedback, criticism, and suggestions!

Save transfer from the demo to the full version will be supported. However, save compatibility between parts is not guaranteed, so the demo is a great opportunity to replay the story from the start.  


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36812856/893f36298acf7d4912ea81e764afeac3fb50576c.png[/img]

notes.title: Heroines of Swords & Spells 2 Announced!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36812856/735d0dbd6a98e354327b7bec7848828b28178ed3.png[/img]

Attention, adventurers! Heroines of Swords & Spells 2 is set to release in 2025! This new installment includes Act 2, which expands and enhances the original game with fresh content. Prepare for new adventures filled with thrilling quests, mysterious locations, dangerous enemies, and hidden secrets. Our lovely yet unlucky heroines are ready to face new challenges, but don’t worry — all the content from Act 1 remains fully playable in this new project.

In Heroines of Swords & Spells 2, players can choose to dive straight into Act 2 with level 8 heroines (perfect for returning fans) or start from the beginning with Act 1 (ideal for newcomers or those who want to relive the story).

After the release of Heroines of Swords & Spells 2, purchasing Act 1 separately will only be necessary for unlocking achievements and Steam trading cards. Of course, you’re also welcome to buy it to support the developer’s creativity — thank you so much for your encouragement!

notes.title: Murder Is Game Over Series Retrospective – Part 1
notes.notes:
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/6138946/92d01e216e79e6660b894f6601cd3cc2b3ee871e.png[/img]

After developing and releasing 3 “Murder Is Game Over” titles in 2 years, I’ve had some time to pause and reflect on what I like most about each one. These are my thoughts on the series as a whole.

Best exploration – Murder Is Game Over

My initial concept for this game was to have a murder mystery that emphasized exploration much more inspired by RPGs than adventure games. In hindsight, the world design from the first game was well done in terms of giving the player freedom to move around the world at their choosing. The map shape is based on a series of interconnecting circles including the castle's ground floor, connecting the second floor and the sealed wing, and finally, a secret passage connecting the castle to the surrounding countryside. The method of murder also relies heavily on the way the map makes a seemingly inaccessible area easy to reach through a clever shortcut. Not only is the exploration mechanic effective for the player, but it also serves as part of the storytelling and narrative.
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/6138946/7f80e1fc4e2a5ded79aded636f18e96e6a8fc179.jpg[/img]

Which game in the series has my favorite villain? Find out in part 2 coming next!

I'm creating the fourth game in the series. Please wishlist it (link below). Thank you for your support!
Matt

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3046150/Murder_Is_Game_Over_The_Blackinton_Curse

notes.title: ⚙️ New game mechanic in Murder Is Game Over: Deal Killer 🕵️‍♂️
notes.notes:
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/6138946/f71305e0bbe3dec1e1167ae3ca37bed63cee3161.png[/img]

❄️🏔️ With Murder Is Game Over: Streaming Death I wanted to introduce the idea of being chased around by a “ghost” like in Scooby-Doo. In the second half of that game, Elias Abel (actually the killer in disguise) randomly appears while exploring and moves toward the player. The easy difficulty mode is very straightforward. The hard difficulty mode also randomizes the time before the ghost appears so that it’s much more unexpected. The world map is designed to provide lots of opportunities for being chased, and lots of space to maneuver around an aggressive ghost.

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/6138946/62d5658c8707f1a3c64a2b2448238df54f425b36.png[/img]

With Murder Is Game Over: Deal Killer instead of going big, the concept was to go small spaces. I wanted the player to get the feeling of claustrophobia and being stuck in a small hotel with nowhere to go. There’s little room for a ghostly crook to hide or sneak around. So this concept got me thinking about what other mechanics I could use for a hero or villain to trick people.

That’s how I came up with the new costume mechanic for this new game in the series. Just because there’s no space to hide doesn’t mean there aren’t other ways that a person can be deceptive. Partway through the game, our detectives discover a trove of costumes that Guy can wear as a disguise. The disguises will prompt instances of mistaken identity and different (sometimes extremely silly) reactions from suspects. The costume theme might also play an essential part in how the crime was committed, and how the detective solves the case. 

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/6138946/c0bbc39daa2f9f9c6e11d1e3089836e51eac9dbc.png[/img]

Do you prefer being chased around a village by a spooky ghost, or being stuck in a mountain top chalet during a blizzard with nowhere to go? As the Murder Is Game Over series continues to evolve, my goal is to come up with different gameplay concepts and mechanics that make each title feel different and unique. 🥸

Thanks for reading!

Matt (indiedev of Murder Is Game Over series) 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2478850/Murder_Is_Game_Over_Deal_Killer/

notes.title: A small announcement
notes.notes:
You may have noticed that in version 1.5 all game' s graphic files are encrypted. This decision was made in order to avoid copyright issues. I honestly don't think it can stop anyone determined enough, but some of the assets that I bought and used have this requirement in the license agreement. And since it's there, I have to comply.

Unfortunately, RPG Maker engine doesn't allow you to encrypt files partially. As a result Tr0yka's art and character sprites from to Heroines of Swords & Spells are now encrypted too. This could become a problem for modders and ordinary players who just want to enjoy the art. After thinking about it, I decided to post these materials on Google and Yandex drive, as well as in the game's Vkontakte group.

You can download the art and character sprites here:
1) [url=https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1YuD3-X0RMjQIjbH_dXvVU59Spt_3YPB4?usp=sharing]Google Drive[/url]
2) [url=https://disk.yandex.ru/d/v82vDS-7W_cWyA?w=1]Yandex Drive[/url]

PS. I'm thinking of implementing an in-game gallery in one of the latter patches, but no promises for now.

notes.title: Heroines of Swords & Spells. DLC Green Furies
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36812856/5f3d7d228d90bd907d48aab8c7b1b5b712d283e7.png[/img]

Last year, on March 17, 2020 my very first PC game, Heroines of Swords & Spells, was released on Steam.
An epic-humorous JRPG with no grind and no random encounters (sounds like an oxymoron, doesn't it?) about the adventures of four charming but wayward heroines. A kind thief, a cowardly warrior, a mischievous priestess, and a mage that can't cast spells. I was inspired by the great and beautiful game Baldur's Gate and the equally epochal and beautiful anime KonoSuba.

Despite:
- a specific plot idea and specific gameplay (the characters are literally level zero when you start playing);
- tons of text that sometimes make the game more like a visual novel;
- a very... unique RPG Maker engine (which many gamers are allergic to)... Despite all this, the project was not stillborn. On the contrary, Heroines of Swords & Spells gained its fans (over 300 reviews on Steam 95% of which are positive). Not much, but not bad.

[url=https://ic.pics.livejournal.com/kirillkrm/30093132/1068532/1068532_original.jpg][img]https://ic.pics.livejournal.com/kirillkrm/30093132/1068532/1068532_original.jpg[/img][/url]

I felt like a real developer. That's why, as a proper developer, I decided to 'make some extra cash' by releasing a DLC. Instead of improving the graphics and making a sequel, of course.

That' s how the idea was born! I decided to write a separate scenario about the four evil goblinettes which goes side-by-side with the main plot. Diana, Anastasia, Svetlana and Felicia had a short encounter with them before the finale of Act I. The players liked the memorable cutscene with the goblinettes and the heated argument between them and the heroines. In fact, they enjoyed it so much I was asked if the four goblin girls would make an appearence in Act II. And the answer is yes. The heroines will cross paths with the Green Furies quite a few times in the future. Needless to say, the goblinettes are another cliché (trope). A rival firm. A polar opposite team. But that's what makes them attractive. Can there be a company of adventurers making more trouble than Diana and her friends? They can! Found them!
Meet witty, but strong Groonya; strong, but witty Gheesha and the undecided Gvaasha and Gloosha.

[url=https://ic.pics.livejournal.com/kirillkrm/30093132/1068668/1068668_original.jpg][img]https://ic.pics.livejournal.com/kirillkrm/30093132/1068668/1068668_original.jpg[/img][/url]

The DLC should take 6 to 8 hours to complete depending on the speed of the player. What kind of speed? Reading speed, of course. Heroines of Swords & Spells was and is a game more about reading than fighting monsters.

However, I reflected on several gameplay moments of Act I and made conclusions. The Anti-Heroines scenario is a preliminary result of said reflection. You could say that the DLC is an attempt to apply how I see Act II gameplay structure. The vision is far from final, but still.

[url=https://ic.pics.livejournal.com/kirillkrm/30093132/1068978/1068978_original.jpg][img]https://ic.pics.livejournal.com/kirillkrm/30093132/1068978/1068978_original.jpg[/img][/url]

The price of the DLC is 3.99$. I won't rule out the possibility of a new DLC in the future, but I don't plan to get carried away with it. I already feel bad for the fact that the game had to cut into several acts. Originally I planned one big project with 50-60 hours of gameplay, but it would take another 3-4 years of seclusion with no feedback from the audience, which would severely influence the game's quality.

Another important detail: the game's kind ambiance is not going anywhere (I hope), but I have to mention that in this particular scenario the player has to "get under the skin of evil" like it or not. Goblinettes aren't "sweet kawaii little things" like the main characters. They're funny in their own way but were brought up in a different society. I'm not pointing any fingers (hey, Diana), but in the main game the girls often didn't give the player (and Svetlana) a chance to do the wrong thing. Green Furies, on the other hand, won't always let you take the high road. Keep this in mind.

[url=https://ic.pics.livejournal.com/kirillkrm/30093132/1069151/1069151_original.jpg][img]https://ic.pics.livejournal.com/kirillkrm/30093132/1069151/1069151_original.jpg[/img][/url]

[url=https://ic.pics.livejournal.com/kirillkrm/30093132/1069517/1069517_original.jpg][img]https://ic.pics.livejournal.com/kirillkrm/30093132/1069517/1069517_original.jpg[/img][/url]

Yeah, goblinettes are by no means fair maidens, but they also have a Goal. Cowravans must be robbed! If not in the name of Good or Light, then at least so that the servants of that Good would have someone to chase through the woods and swamps.

The Light, of course, will triumph, but the true Anti-Heroines will not give up so easily!

[url=https://ic.pics.livejournal.com/kirillkrm/30093132/1069617/1069617_original.jpg][img]https://ic.pics.livejournal.com/kirillkrm/30093132/1069617/1069617_original.jpg[/img][/url]

notes.title: Version 1.5
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36812856/b15fd871ea18589849617c08633a1bf78bbb485a.jpg[/img]

[previewyoutube=9dlcLEwpABQ;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]The game has got a major update v1.5.[/b]

[b]With the 1.5 update introduced, the demo now contains Act I (full version), except for the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1511510/Green_Furies/]Green Furies DLC.[/url][/b] The Heroines of Swords & Spells demo is also available on Steam, but buying the game will give you access to achievements, cards and other community items, and also will be of great help to me.

[i]The main changes:[/i]
1) New large portraits by Tr0yka, our artist (main characters only);
2) New cutscenes by Tr0yka;
3) Slightly reworked the balance. E.g. Meat Shield state is now removed by Fear. This means that Anastasia will no longer be able to cover her friends when she's in frightened state
4) Several game maps (mostly streets) were redrawn.
5) The English version of the game has undergone through some changes too. A number of hard-to-pronounce Slavic names and places have been adapted for the English speaking. For example, the surname "Strizhinsky" is now translated as "the Swifts". Anastasia Strizhinskaya became Anastasia Swift, and Strizhinsk was changed to Swifton. Being the creator of this world, this decision was not an easy one for me, but hopefully the adaptation of difficult to pronounce Russian names will make it easier for people to understand and enjoy the game.

v1.5 screenshots:
[url=https://ic.pics.livejournal.com/kirillkrm/30093132/1064222/1064222_original.jpg][img]https://ic.pics.livejournal.com/kirillkrm/30093132/1064222/1064222_original.jpg[/img][/url]

[url=https://ic.pics.livejournal.com/kirillkrm/30093132/1064636/1064636_original.jpg][img]https://ic.pics.livejournal.com/kirillkrm/30093132/1064636/1064636_original.jpg[/img][/url]

[url=https://ic.pics.livejournal.com/kirillkrm/30093132/1064765/1064765_original.jpg][img]https://ic.pics.livejournal.com/kirillkrm/30093132/1064765/1064765_original.jpg[/img][/url]

[url=https://ic.pics.livejournal.com/kirillkrm/30093132/1064999/1064999_original.png][img]https://ic.pics.livejournal.com/kirillkrm/30093132/1064999/1064999_original.png[/img][/url]

Also on April 15th a DLC called Green Furies is going to be released. The DLC is not free, but the price is quite a bargain.
The DLC includes a separate game scenario about the four evil, greedy, but cute (in their own way) goblinettes. An 'anti-heroic' team of rival protagonists.

The Green Furies scenario should take around 7+ hours to finish. As with the main campaign, the main emphasis in the DLC is on the story, jokes and dialogues. The player will have to read a lot and, of course, understand what is written.
Anyone who decides to go down the wrong path of anti-heroism with the goblinettes should expect:
1. Four new playable characters, each with unique personality traits that affect gameplay;
2. New story and side quests with a variety of playthrough options;
3. A small but ready to be explored goblin cave;
4. Engaging bosses and some original equipment.

I have to note that the DLC scenario is designed for experienced players who are familiar with the story of the main campaign, the world lore and gameplay mechanics. If you haven't played Heroines of Swords & Spells, rushing to buy Green Furies DLC may not be the best decision as far as I'm concerned, but it’s still up to you.

notes.title: Heroines of Swords & Spells. One year later.
notes.notes:
[url=https://ic.pics.livejournal.com/kirillkrm/30093132/1052729/1052729_original.jpg][img]https://ic.pics.livejournal.com/kirillkrm/30093132/1052729/1052729_original.jpg[/img][/url]
[b]Good news, everyone! Today the Heroines celebrate their first birthday! [/b]
The game Heroines of Swords & Spells was released on Steam exactly one year ago, on March 17, 2020. Since then, over 5000 copies of the game have been sold. Certainly not bad for a project made in RPG Maker, don’t you think?

I give my thanks to everyone who agreed to spend their time and money on my modest yet epic and humorous game. In this year, the project has grown a relatively small but loyal fanbase. People are waiting for a sequel, and that motivates me to continue working on the project.

I had planned to release a large-scale DLC about four evil goblettes — Diana and her friends’ rivals. Alas, I did not have enough time. The deadline had to be pushed back. The translation is not finished, the art is not ready yet, the project's page on Steam also leaves a great deal to be desired. The worst thing is that it took a lot of time to port the game to Android devices, yet I am still highly dissatisfied with the quality of the port. 

It became impossible to release the DLC exactly on the game’s release anniversary due to these drawbacks. So, I decided to act like a real politician before an important election — that is, to start promising how good everything will be for everyone... later. Just hold on for a little longer, scout’s honor. And if the anti-heroic DLC will not be released at the end of March then it certainly will be by mid-April. Please note me not specifying the year.

Apart from the DLC there are some important core game updates waiting to be implemented. A major 1.5 patch is coming out soon where our heroines will show themselves at their best. Literally!

[url=https://ic.pics.livejournal.com/kirillkrm/30093132/1052994/1052994_original.jpg][img]https://ic.pics.livejournal.com/kirillkrm/30093132/1052994/1052994_original.jpg[/img][/url]

[url=https://ic.pics.livejournal.com/kirillkrm/30093132/1053234/1053234_original.jpg][img]https://ic.pics.livejournal.com/kirillkrm/30093132/1053234/1053234_original.jpg[/img][/url]

[url=https://ic.pics.livejournal.com/kirillkrm/30093132/1053589/1053589_original.jpg][img]https://ic.pics.livejournal.com/kirillkrm/30093132/1053589/1053589_original.jpg[/img][/url]

Starting with version 1.5 the girls will get big(ger) dialog portraits done by our one and only artist, Tr0yka. However, if some of you prefer the old look, you’ll easily find the option to turn this new feature off in the game settings. Anything for my dearest players. Alas, the simple NPCs’ portraits will remain unchanged.

Some locations, mostly streets, will be redrawn too. Here is how, for example, Strizhinsk will be transformed under the archconsul’s reign.

Prior to v. 1.5:
[url=https://ic.pics.livejournal.com/kirillkrm/30093132/1053850/1053850_original.jpg][img]https://ic.pics.livejournal.com/kirillkrm/30093132/1053850/1053850_original.jpg[/img][/url]

After v. 1.5
[url=https://ic.pics.livejournal.com/kirillkrm/30093132/1054150/1054150_original.jpg][img]https://ic.pics.livejournal.com/kirillkrm/30093132/1054150/1054150_original.jpg[/img][/url]

Other changes will be more clandestine, but trust me, many small things have been tinkered with. Old save files should work normally even after the changes.

In addition to the graphics the gameplay balance will be slightly tuned as well. Anastasia’s Meat shield skill effect will now be removed if one of the following debuffs are applied: Stun, Charm, Confusion etc. That is, Anastasia won’t be able to tank in any situation when the player can’t control her.

The 1.5 version also introduces a new legendary achievement to the main campaign and a couple of new pictures for the cutscenes.
But the main course of the upcoming changes is of course the anti-heroines scenario. I am sick at heart to tell you the grave news but the DLC won’t be free.

[url=https://ic.pics.livejournal.com/kirillkrm/30093132/1054342/1054342_original.jpg][img]https://ic.pics.livejournal.com/kirillkrm/30093132/1054342/1054342_original.jpg[/img][/url]

The story of four goblin girls is designed for 7+ hours of gameplay. That’s how long it took for the testers to finish the DLC.


The players will lead four relatively new characters down the crooked path of "anti-heroism". 
[url=https://ic.pics.livejournal.com/kirillkrm/30093132/1054619/1054619_800.png][img]https://ic.pics.livejournal.com/kirillkrm/30093132/1054619/1054619_800.png[/img][/url]
[b]Groonya[/b]
The leader and troublemaker of our anti-heroic party, and the instigator that egged on the other goblettes to join her searching for adventure, or rather, misadventure. Among the greenskins Groonya stands out for her tall stature (almost that of an average human) and strong fists. She says that she is the strongest in the tribe after the chief, but no one believes her, of course. Never before has a woman been able to compete with the best male warriors. However, for some reason none of the aforementioned best warriors are too eager to go head-to-head with her. In addition to her great strength, Groonya's mouth is full of needle-sharp teeth — a mutation not uncommon among goblins. With her superb appetite Grunya can't help but try and take a bite out of her prey.


[url=https://ic.pics.livejournal.com/kirillkrm/30093132/1054960/1054960_800.png][img]https://ic.pics.livejournal.com/kirillkrm/30093132/1054960/1054960_800.png[/img][/url]
[b]Gvaasha[/b]
Groonya’s best friend who does the thinking for both of them. A cunning and green gob-brain. Gvaasha knows how to use lockpicks, although her specialization is that of a rogue rather than a thief. For obvious reasons she wasn’t trained in the Thieves Guild, nor does she have a badge that makes it easier to lockpick chests and disarm traps. But unlike the good-hearted Diana our troublemaker has a sneaky but effective trick. Gvaasha never misses an opportunity to throw a handful of sand in her opponent's eyes. The very notion of fair play is deeply alien to most goblins, and our anti-heroine is no exception. What’s absolutely not alien for Gvaasha is an itch for money. Like a thieving magpie, she is willing to stick her long nose into all sorts of trouble for the sake of shinies.


[url=https://ic.pics.livejournal.com/kirillkrm/30093132/1055021/1055021_800.png][img]https://ic.pics.livejournal.com/kirillkrm/30093132/1055021/1055021_800.png[/img][/url]
[b]Gloosha[/b]
A young huntress who learned to use a bow, Gloosha shoots quickly and accurately. However, all her attempts to tame a pet have failed so far. But Gloosha doesn’t despair and tries not to take other goblins’ mockery to heart. She is generally quite cheerful and doesn't like to have the blues for a long time. Gloosha always has something in store to ‘cheer up’ her friends. Her sense of humor, however, is slightly peculiar. Gloosha's jokes often confuse other goblettes. Thankfully, they are sure (almost) that her jokes are just that.


[url=https://ic.pics.livejournal.com/kirillkrm/30093132/1055328/1055328_800.png][img]https://ic.pics.livejournal.com/kirillkrm/30093132/1055328/1055328_800.png[/img][/url]
[b]Gheesha[/b]
She used to be thought of as the prettiest among goblins until one fine day she suddenly discovered that apart from being just eaten mushrooms can also be talked to. Gheesha set her mind to serving Gmyrmork, the god of goblins. Unfortunately, among the greenskins magic has always been considered men's business, so the high shaman did not appreciate Gheesha’s newly awakened talent. He even forbade his apprentices to allow the obstinate goblette into the shrine. Despite having a mentor, however, Gheesha was able to master a number of spells, including the regeneration spell. This made some other goblettes curious about her.

[url=https://ic.pics.livejournal.com/kirillkrm/30093132/1055600/1055600_original.jpg][img]https://ic.pics.livejournal.com/kirillkrm/30093132/1055600/1055600_original.jpg[/img][/url]

To tell the truth, I'm a little worried seeing this group of ani-heroic misfits banded together. How would you, the player, feel walking in green evil’s shoes, even if for a short 7+ hours hike, especially after walking the path hand in hand with our sweet, kind and sympathetic heroines (Svetlana, am I right?). 

I tried to give players more freedom in the DLC, but just like in the main game, the outcome of some events is determined by the characters’ personalities, not by the player's decisions. Those fond of Diana's honesty and willingness to share an extra (or not) coin with those in need, may feel uncomfortable about some of Gvaasha’s decisions.

However, Heroines of Swords & Spells is a kind-hearted fairytale which means that Light will drive away the Darkness, and Good will surely prevail over Evil. But for the victory of all that is good over all that is not to come out as truly heroic, our evil pretties must also grow. As they say in the ancient scrolls, without the anti-hero there will be no Event!

notes.title: 1.1 Update is out! Long-awaited Steam badges are finally here. Enjoy!
notes.notes:
Good news, everyone! Guess who got brand new trading cards today? You, that’s who!
Heroines of Swords & Spells (finally) updated to ver. 1.1

What’s new:
1.    Steam community now has HoSS trading cards and all the bells and whistles like emoticons, badges, yada-yada… so you can hoard them like a dragon or share like you care.
2.    The help menu interface suffered some changes and got better.
3.    You can leave Temple of Laverna without defeating the boss now.
4.    Mimic now has a new look (by Avery).
5.    Last (hopefully) batch of minor bugs and typos was dealt with.

I'm happy to announce that the project is finally complete and ready (unless something extraordinary happens) to be ported to the other platforms. I’ll keep you updated through the community groups. Act II is well underway and I have a lot of big ideas and improvements in mind, but the work has just begun, so the game will not be out anytime soon. I'm preparing a small gift for you, however, and I sincerely hope you get to enjoy it by the end of this year. Ho-ho-ho!

notes.title: Version 1.07
notes.notes:
Good news, everyone! Patch 1.07 is finally out. Here's what's new:
- All chickens learned to cluck (click them to test it out).
- Another batch of text fixes (both ENG and RUS). Pesky typos are pesky!

notes.title: Version 1.07
notes.notes:
Update 1.07. The list of major changes:
1.	Heroines sprites updated. Credits to Promestein. If they receive a warm welcome one of the next patches will change all NPC’s sprites to the similar looking ones. 
2.	Added surrender option to the battle menu. Now you can Surrender in a hopeless fight than you can’t retreat from. To use it press Esc (same as Retreat).
3.	Boss goblins’ Attack, Defense, Luck and HP increased. Ordinary goblins’ stats are the same.
4.	Diana’s kind big heart grew bigger (when certain conditions are met your coin purse can lose а whooping sum of 1500 coins).
5.	Corrected all known bugs and typos (including the elder bug with the elemental in the city sewers). 
If you reported a bug but it’s still present after this patch there’s a high chance I’ve forgotten about it. Sorry! Please be kind to inform me one more time.

notes.title: Version 1.051
notes.notes:
Important notice: version 1.05 hotfix.
Fury and Exhausting haste didn't work together in 1.05, so I fixed it in 1.051.
Got rid of the bug which broke the party order during Repairing the Bathhouse quest if you chose to send Felicia to fight. If you have this problem go to Yonka and rest at aunt Agafia's house. The party order will return to the way it should be.

notes.title: Version 1.05
notes.notes:
Good news, everyone! Game is now updated to ver. 1.05.
What's new:
1) You can now switch to fullscreen mode form the Options menu (previously fullscreen was available only by pressing F4).
2) Fixed the bug that made footsteps audible again after turning their sound of in the options and then quitting the game.
3) Increased the item stack size from 99 to 999 items. Time to pick up some daisies!
4) Scrolls now work as described.
5) Fixed the bug that made you lose lockpics if you used them in the inventory.
6) "Astrological buff" now gives bonuses to enemies' mana and hp, as well as increases their attack, defence and speed.
7)  "Astrological buff" now correctly buffs giant scorpions and giant slugs during corresponding week.
8) More localization fixes, mapping fixes and minor tweaks.

notes.title: Version 1.04
notes.notes:
Good news, everyone! It’s been a week since Heroines of Swords & Spells was released and everything’s smooth as silk. You bought more than 500 copies of the game and it might not seem that great, but it kinda is. Well, at least in my book. Alas, most of the players are from Russia, although there are several English-speaking players and they even review the game (thank you from the bottom of my heart!). This makes me a bit sad, so if you have friends abroad, please tell them about my game.

Moving on to the patch notes. The game was updated to ver. 1.04: 
- Minor mapping fixes: some passable tiles are now impassable.
- Less typos. 
- Added an in-game notice near the point of no return (after which you will not be able to complete side quests anymore.

I am currently working on 1.05 patch because I received several letters asking about the possibility of going back to playing after finishing the main quest to walk around and finish all remaining quests. There’s a hitch, though. As I am planning to transfer your progress to Act II, I need the game to end at a predetermined point (it wouldn’t work any other way). So the post-main quest gameplay is… well… special, and let’s leave it at that. 

Anyway, I’d like to thank everyone who bought the game and especially those who wrote a review. I’ll keep on fixing errors, but there will not be any content patches as I’m moving on to work on Act II. I hope you’ll keep supporting the game and are as excited about what happens next as I am!

notes.title: Version 1.03
